name: Status report — shift 4 (18 Nov 2026): reviewed tree corrected to 5 authored files, 4 of them unowned
description:
## TL; DR;

**Status: AT RISK.** The tree management is asked to approve on **19 Nov at 08:00** is bigger than I reported last shift. It is not "one document file plus machine noise" — it is **5 real files**, and **4 of them had no owner, no card and no acceptance criteria**. One of those four is a **157-line customer-facing page describing a feature nobody has confirmed is released**. Approving the tree as-is would stamp "reviewed" on an unowned, unverified product page.

What I did about it: opened `2410a44c` (owner `biblio`, verdict due 19 Nov 12:00) and gave the approver a clean per-file approve / hold / reject recommendation. I also fixed a scheduling mistake I had made — M6 was set to wake 50 minutes before its own demo, so it could never have been shown.

**Decision needed from management, by 19 Nov 08:00:** approve the contract, the attribution spec and the `.codx` ignore file; **hold** the voice page and its two nav lines; **reject** the ~32 files of agent bookkeeping. Details in option A below.

---

## 1. Summary

Goal: make the QA/security gate trustworthy enough to gate releases. This shift corrected the **scope of the change under approval** — four unowned files were sitting inside it, including a customer-facing page for an unreleased feature.

Business outcome: an approval that means what it says. Right now "approved" would not distinguish a reviewed delivery contract from an unowned marketing page.

## 2. Scope of this increment (sprint 18–21 Nov)

**In:** QA suite declaration (M2), attributable security reviewer (M5), untracked agent runtime state (M6), provenance verdict on the 4 unowned files, sprint demo on 21 Nov.
**Out:** any code change to the QA/CISO engines (blocked — see §4), the platform API repo (`api/` + `client/`) which remains ungated (`42c8d580`), and the voice-conversation feature itself.

## 3. Increment plan

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 — delivery contract (decision C) | `delivery-contract.md` +44/−13, **uncommitted** | human (`a8be6182`) | 19 Nov | yes (doc) | yes | **AT RISK** — awaiting approval |
| M2 — apply `qa_policy` | docs test suite declared | human (`e684ce5c`) | 20 Nov | yes | yes | **BLOCKED** — no agent has write access to `.codx/project.json` |
| M5 — attributable security reviewer | group by rule+path, never block without a reachable `path:line` | `software_developer` (`17efa3eb`) | 21 Nov | yes | yes | doing, 60% |
| M6 — stop versioning `.codx` state | `.gitignore` + `git rm --cached` | `software_developer` (`8909f356`) | 20 Nov | yes | yes | doing, 40% · wake fixed |
| Intake — 4 unowned files | provenance + verdict on the voice page | `biblio` (`2410a44c`) | 20 Nov | n/a | n/a | **new**, wake 19 Nov 12:00 |
| Sprint review & demo | honest close of the sprint | ProjectManager (`f6d1855e`) | 21 Nov | — | yes | scheduled, agenda amended |

## 4. Dependencies & critical path

`a8be6182` (approve 19 Nov) → M1 committed → **M6 can then touch the tree** (moving `.codx` files while they are under review would invalidate the approval) → M6 demoable 20 Nov → demo 21 Nov.

Critical path: **M2 is on it and it is human-only.** Applying `qa_policy` needs write access to `.codx/project.json`; no profile in this project has it. It is a two-minute paste and it gates the whole "green" claim.

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unowned docs content approved by accident | High — "reviewed" status on an unverified page | Medium | `2410a44c`; per-file verdict to approver | `biblio` | **yes** |
| M2 never applied → gate stays red | High — sprint closes without its main claim | Medium | Human paste, wake 20 Nov 08:00 | mgmt | **yes** |
| M6 edits the tree under review | Medium — invalidates the approval | **Low now** — wake moved after the verdict | Sequenced 20 Nov 09:30 | `software_developer` | no |
| Voice page published for an unreleased feature | Medium — customer-visible overclaim | Unknown | Hold the page + nav until provenance is proven | `biblio` | **yes** |

## 6. Decisions needed from management

1. **Approve the tree — recommended option A (decide by 19 Nov 08:00).**
   - **A (recommended):** approve `delivery-contract.md`, `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` and `.codx/.gitignore`; **hold** `features/voice-conversation.md` + its 2 nav lines; **reject** the ~32 `.codx` runtime files.
   - B: approve everything — fastest, but grants reviewed status to unowned content.
   - C: reject the whole tree — blocks M1 and gains nothing.
2. **Apply `qa_policy` yourself (by 20 Nov 08:00)** — options: paste it (2 min), or accept that the sprint closes with the gate still red.

## 7. Next demo & checkpoint

**21 Nov, ~10 minutes**, on the demo environment. Management will see: M6 actually working (`git status` clean after an agent shift, CISO findings back to zero on `.codx`), M5's attributable output, and the honest status of M2 and the intake verdict. Team needs the deployable tree from 20 Nov and the `biblio` verdict by 19 Nov 12:00.

## 8. Demo script

1. Run an agent shift, then `git status` → no `.codx/autonomy|harness|chat_turns` noise (M6).
2. `security_audit(path=".codx")` → allow, with the before/after finding count (M6 kills ~1000 FPs).
3. Show the per-file approve/hold/reject table from `a8be6182` — the aggregate is what hid the problem.
4. State M2's status plainly with owner and date.
5. Ask management: keep the voice page in this increment or defer it?

---

**Worked with `project_changes` only — no repository file was written this shift, deliberately: adding documentation now would enlarge the very diff under review.**

## Delta — turn 4 of shift 4 (18 Nov), after this report was filed

Two further board defects found by auditing the sprint for **demo-readiness** (can every card in the agenda actually be shown at 21 Nov 08:30?), not found by any agent report:

| card | defect | fix |
|---|---|---|
| `3fb379ae` "no test suite declared" | due **21 Nov** — the demo day — while being **step 2 of the demo agenda** (`f6d1855e`) | due → **2026-11-20**; wake unchanged 20 Nov 09:00 |
| `6c697929` "false green via `run_tests=False`" | **`sprints: []`** and **no assignee**, yet its own text says it blocks this demo | added to sprint `QA gate hardening (18-21 Nov 2026)`, owner `software_developer` |

**Why it matters more than it looks.** This is the **third** instance in two shifts of the same defect class — a card that the demo depends on but that is not committed before, or not even inside, the sprint: `19883bdd` (outside sprint, shift 3), `8909f356` M6 and `17efa3eb` M5 (wake armed *after* their own demo, shift 4), now `3fb379ae` and `6c697929`. The board was "green" each time. The pattern is structural, not a one-off, and it is the single most likely way this sprint closes on 21 Nov with an empty demo slot.

**Corrected count for the increment plan in this report:** all five demo-relevant milestones (`a8be6182`, `e684ce5c`, `8909f356`, `3fb379ae`, `17efa3eb`, plus `2410a44c`) are now due **on or before 20 Nov**, i.e. committed before the 21 Nov 08:30 review. `6c697929` is due 20 Nov too. **Nothing in this sprint is dued on demo morning.**

**Adding to the sprint changes the sprint's scope count:** it is now **13 cards**, not the 11 stated in the shift-3 baseline and not the 12 implied earlier in this shift. The 21 Nov review should present 13, of which at most 6 can realistically be shown — hence the recommendation to keep the demo agenda at M6 + M5 + blockers, and to show the rest as "not demonstrated, owner named".

**Unchanged and still blocking:** `a8be6182` (human approval, 19 Nov 08:00 — recommendation **A**), `e684ce5c` (human `qa_policy` paste, 20 Nov 08:00), `82314f38` (human `git rm --cached`, needs a shell).

**Still no repository file written this shift** — the working tree is the artefact under review tomorrow morning.
